title: Neural Bellman Operators: residual-tube follow-up
primary_target: Full adapted-policy recursive-cost bound on the declared initial ball; complete service work for the identical frozen candidate generators.
paired_diagnostic: Apply R27 box verifier to every same returned policy; retain every failure and charge its time separately.
interpretation: Follow-up designed after observing R27, frozen before its own complete execution. Deterministic finite catalogue, not a population confidence statement. Neither verifier success nor closing interval wrapping establishes a neural work advantage.
success_rule: Compare outward full-policy bound to 1e-4; no selected retry, tolerance relaxation, omitted regime or changed generator.
historical_rule: Original R27 outcomes and clocks remain unchanged. New clocks are not compared across machines or treated as repeated observations.
